interpretation_update.adey_count_meaning: Adey model-page counts are category/search-result listing totals. The model pages explicitly say listings from sellers, show seller counts, pagination, individual item URLs, and price summaries. They are not popularity indicators, registrations, or sales.
interpretation_update.toyota_bz_series_caution: The 1,021 count from the Adey grouped Toyota bZ-series page is not attributed to bZ4X specifically. bZ4X evidence is recorded only from the dedicated Toyota bZ4X catalogue page.
interpretation_update.vehicle_selection_status: BYD Seagull and BYD Yuan Up remain strong preliminary candidates. The third vehicle is not finalized.
interpretation_update.price_schema: Platform-reported typical_price is stored separately from calculated_average_price and calculated_median_price. No calculated average or median is stored in this batch.
